datasetAttribution.title: Have protein-ligand cofolding methods moved beyond memorisation? — Runs N’ Poses
datasetAttribution.modifications: Molarium selected a native-positive diagnostic cohort, prepared portable experimental scoring references, and generated original stock LocalFold browser predictions. These review exports preserve the existing prediction PDB strings and explicit ligand graphs; experimental references are separately labelled. No AlphaFold3 coordinate output is redistributed.

provenance.purpose: Human inspection of preserved output; no copied decisions or correctness labels.
provenance.coordinatePolicy: Every exported PDB string is byte-identical to its preserved prediction or experimental reference. Viewer alignment is display-only.
provenance.timingPolicy: elapsedMs is unavailable because recorded launcher wall time is not isolated inference time.

component.chemistrySource: Explicit RnP reference SDF topology and coordinates, exact isomeric input-graph agreement; reference atom labels identify SDF/template indices.

provenance.purpose: Display/scoring reference, never supplied to inference.
